**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** 2024-2026 issues show phenomenological/philosophical psychopathology, axiological/value-based models of depression, conceptual analysis of psychiatric diagnosis/reification, philosophy of eating disorders, and a distinct recent cluster on psychedelics (metaphysics of self, transformative experience, informed consent in psychedelic-assisted therapy).

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** conceptual/philosophical analysis, phenomenological description and analysis, case-based philosophical/clinical commentary, cross-disciplinary commentary/debate format (target article + commentaries), ethics and philosophy of psychedelic-assisted therapy, philosophy of diagnosis/nosology
